scientific_integrity: Mathematical proof of the exact all-graph polynomial is included. Finite state enumeration of 1,821,396 cases is corroboration rather than proof for arbitrary graph orders. The source anchor is the first publicly dated arXiv version of the 37B15-primary source; other references are contextual.
scientific_limitations: Counts only primitive two-cycle orbits of standard synchronous degree-threshold firing on finite connected simple graphs. Does not classify other possible periods, basins, or transients. Full Bitar–Goles (1992) original text not available; unindexed equivalence remains possible.
title: Cut-degree census and maximum-cut thresholds for period-two chip-firing
